event: The party reaches the Floor 8 rest node: a carved limestone alcove above a glowing pool.
The organized sound Tomás reported turns out to be water running through the limestone.
Tomás checks the perimeter and nods; the party spreads out to rest.
Vesper sets up the Field Forge while Miriam records the Mana density in her notebook.
Solenne rereads the notes she wrote three hours ago, then closes her notebook.
Solenne tells the party she wants to try something.
She names it: a deliberate, prepared Harmonize, not the accidental Floor 6 contact.
Nadia asks if it will hurt; Solenne says she doesn't think so.
Nadia offers Tomás a bet that Solenne fumbles it; Tomás does not take it.
Solenne sits and says she will first explain all she thinks is happening.
Six Harmony Aspects: Steadfast, Warmhearted, Openhanded, Clearvoiced, Brightspirit, Trueweave.
She describes each Aspect as a mode of connection the System can measure.
She names all six of them as carriers: Dayo Steadfast, Miriam Warmhearted, Vesper Openhanded.
Tomás Clearvoiced, Nadia Brightspirit, and herself Trueweave.
Miriam asks if their paired Harmony Skills are two Aspects interacting; Solenne says yes.
Solenne names Unbroken Line and Cartographer's Truth as two such pairings.
Miriam asks if the warmth in Mending Touch is Warmhearted at work; Solenne thinks so.
Tomás asks if the System has confirmed the six-Aspect structure.
Solenne admits it is inference from partial documents, but the System hasn't denied it.
Tomás weighs it and nods once.
Vesper's Field Forge turns out two Tier II healing potions and two Mana Vials.
Vesper shows a prototype armored wrap for the gap in Dayo's left bracer.
The wrap gives plus five Physical Defense against limb strikes, not yet inscribed.
Dayo tests the wrap; Vesper tells her not to thank her before it is finished.
Dayo sets the wrap carefully within reach beside her.
Solenne goes to Dayo and asks her to direct Anchor at her, actively.
Dayo says she has never directed it; it has run passive since before it had a name.
Dayo closes her eyes, plants her weight, and aims Anchor at Solenne.
Solenne feels the Anchor change from a field to a beam through the Resonance Map.
Solenne activates Harmonize and reaches across to the Steadfast Aspect.
Contact holds four seconds: Solenne feels Dayo's loyalty as load-bearing architecture.
The contact drops; Solenne opens eyes she did not know she had closed.
Dayo looks at her quietly, unsure how she feels about being felt so directly.
The System updates Anchor: partial conscious direction enabled for Dayo.
The Party Record logs Harmonize: four seconds, partial synchronization, Aspect contact.
Nadia asks them to rank it on a weirdness scale; Dayo says four, Solenne eight.
Nadia says the numbers are bad and she is keeping them anyway.
Three sets of heavy boots approach down the corridor.
Tomás has his bow in hand, undrawn, before the first shadow appears.
Three strangers enter: a man in plate, a woman Artificer, and a slight Rogue.
The Rogue leans on the far wall; Arcane Analysis reads only Level 14, Rogue.
The man introduces himself: Brennan Cole, Apex Syndicate, Team Ironwall, with Prita and Hex.
Solenne introduces herself: Solenne Achebe-Park, independent.
Brennan says they cleared Floor 7 ahead of his team, unexpectedly for their levels.
Solenne credits good route data, which is true but not the whole truth.
Brennan says they will rest here before the Floor 8 boss; Solenne agrees there's room.
Brennan settles his team: Hex on the far wall, himself near the corridor entrance.
Prita goes to stand two meters from Vesper's Field Forge.
Prita asks Vesper's Tier; Vesper says Tier II, field conditions.
Prita notes Vesper's unusual binding ratios; Vesper says she adjusts for Mana density.
Prita praises the layering of the armored wrap; Vesper thanks her.
Vesper senses Prita's craft stops at the object, while her own reaches the person.
Brennan draws Solenne aside and names their six classes; she confirms Full Complement.
Brennan says Ironwall runs three, Warrior, Artificer, Rogue, and fills gaps with gear.
He says six-archetype teams fall apart by Floor 5 or do something interesting.
Brennan offers Apex resources on Floor 8, with the polite kind of strings.
Solenne thanks him; Brennan returns to his post by the entrance.
Solenne notes the level gap: Brennan 16, Prita 15, Hex 14, her party ten to eleven.
Solenne writes Team Ironwall in her notebook: behind them, not the advance climber.
She turns over three threads: the Quest, the sealed doors, the advance climber.
Dayo sits silent against the wall beside the wrap, feeling something with no route.
Nadia sits between the two teams, cleaning a throwing knife and humming.
Miriam writes in her clinical notebook about the warmth of the contact.
Tomás watches the corridor, and watches Brennan watch it.
Solenne closes the notebook, leans back, and lets the quiet hold her.
